_comment: REJECTION FIXTURE: a read-only tool requesting coupons.read_write. Salla grants scopes per app installation, so an over-broad ask hands the whole app more power over every merchant's store than this tool needs.

interface.name: list_coupons_overbroad
interface.title: List Coupons
interface.description: Lists the discount coupons configured in the store.
whenToUse: The merchant asks which coupons exist.
whenNotToUse: The merchant names one coupon -- use get_coupon instead.
